verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has an optional built-in LLM chat window, delivered via its AI plugin, that can link to terminal sessions. It gives context-aware help, explains output with annotations, and can run commands on your behalf, so a user can ask it about a failed command's output. Community reports confirm the feature exists, is opt-in, and needs the user's own API key. However, nothing shows it detecting failures or offering fixes on its own; the user has to open the chat and ask. missing for 10: automatic detection of failed commands with proactive explanations and fixes, documentation or hands-on evidence of the error-explanation and fix-suggestion workflow specifically.
